title: Across the roofs, unnoticed
odia:
ଚାଳେ ଚାଳେ ଗଲା ଚାଳୁଆ ମୁଷା
କେହି ନଜାଣିଲେ ସାଇ ପଡିଶା।
literal_meaning: The roof-dwelling rat went from roof to roof; none of the neighbours knew.
meaning_odia: ଚାଳରେ ରହୁଥିବା ମୂଷା ଚାଳେ ଚାଳେ ଚାଲିଗଲା, ଅଥଚ ସାଇପଡ଼ିଶା କେହି ଜାଣିଲେ ନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ପାଖରେ ଲୋକ ଥାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଅଜାଣତରେ କୌଣସି କାମ ହୋଇଯିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏହା।
explanation: The rat passes along the roofs while the neighbours remain unaware. Read editorially, the couplet describes something accomplished quietly, beyond the notice of people close by. The second line makes the lack of witnesses the point of the scene.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A small arrangement is completed quietly before anyone nearby hears about it. When it finally becomes known, someone recalls the rat that crossed the roofs unnoticed.
cultural_context: The repetition ଚାଳେ ଚାଳେ carries the movement across roofs, and ଚାଳୁଆ identifies the rat with that setting. The second line shifts attention from the moving animal to the neighbours who know nothing of its passage.

graphic.alt: A rat moves along a tiled roof while four people below remain occupied with reading and household tasks.
graphic.caption: An imagined rooftop journey passes unnoticed above everyday activity.

odia_summary: ପାଖରେ ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଅଜାଣତରେ କାମ ହୋଇଯିବାର ଚିତ୍ର।
english_summary: A quiet passage escapes the neighbours’ notice.
